title: The Tournament Concludes
next_chapter_hook: The night wind cuts like a blade as Su Qingyao's footsteps sound behind him. Her voice carries an unprecedented seriousness: "Chen Ji, that turtle shell in your sleeve—where did you get it?"

text.content: At the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena, dust has yet to settle. Lin Xiao's departing figure vanishes at the end of the corridor, leaving only the shattered pieces of a communication jade slip, glinting dully in the sunlight. The hidden communication has already begun. And at this moment, the fervor of the Sect Competition is sweeping every corner, with no one noticing the gloomy gaze of this Outer Disciple Overseer.

"Third match, Outer Disciple/Servant Chen Ji versus the Artifact Cultivation Hall's Zhou Cheng!" The referee's voice echoes across the Martial Arena, drawing bursts of laughter. A servant disciple facing a formal disciple from the Artifact Cultivation Hall? This is the most absurd pairing in Tianqing Sect Competition history. Among the crowd, several Inner Disciples have even started betting—how many moves can Chen Ji last against Zhou Cheng.

dialogue.content: "Three moves." Chen Ji murmurs to himself, voice audible only to his own ears.

text.content: Zhou Cheng holds a black iron heavy sword, his face full of contempt as he steps onto the Arena Platform. His cultivation has reached Qi Refining Seventh Stage, and the aura of his spiritual artifact flows around him—far beyond what ordinary Outer Disciples can compare to. "Trash, be smart and get down yourself. Don't waste my time." Zhou Cheng can't even be bothered to glance at Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: "Brother Zhou is absolutely right." Chen Ji bows slightly, his posture respectfully impeccable, "It's just that sect rules forbid师弟 from surrendering without fighting. Please go easy on me, Brother." His tone is sincere, even带着几分timid，完美地契合了传言中的废材形象。

text.content: However, the moment the referee announces the start— Chen Ji moves. His figure flashes like a specter across the three zhang distance, a green light flashing from his sleeve. It precisely strikes the spiritual meridian point on Zhou Cheng's wrist. The black iron heavy sword flies from his grasp. Before Zhou Cheng can react, a surge of spiritual power seals his dantian. One move. Just one move, and the Artifact Cultivation Hall's formal disciple stands frozen in place, unable to move.

dialogue.content: "This..." "What happened!" The laughter around the Martial Arena stops abruptly, replaced by dead silence. In the Inner Sect viewing area, several gazes sharpen simultaneously. One comes from Xuanwu Sect genius Han Lie—his originally indifferent eyes now fix on this Outer Disciple/Servant for the first time.

text.content: Chen Ji has already retreated to the edge of the Arena Platform, his expression still timid: "Brother, you've been too kind." Zhou Cheng's face flushes red, his eyes full of disbelief. His spiritual meridians are sealed—he cannot channel energy for a short time. This is the greatest humiliation of his cultivation life. And what angers him more is that thistrash disciple clearly had strength, yet played a role from beginning to end! "You—" Zhou Cheng tries to speak, but the referee's announcement cuts him off: "Chen Ji wins!"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji wins three consecutive matches, overwhelming in momentum. His next opponent is the number one Outer Disciple Zhao Tieshan, whose cultivation has reached Qi Refining Ninth Stage. How should Chen Ji handle this battle?

choices.text: Continue pretending to be weak, barely eke out a narrow victory.
choices.description: Display some strength but not enough to pose a threat, maintain thetrash persona, letting everyone continue to underestimate him.
choices.visible_reward: Keep a low profile, safely advance to the finals
choices.risk_hint: May cause some people to underestimate him even more, requiring more performance later

text.content: The showdown with Zhao Tieshan unfolds as everyone predicted. Chen Ji maintains his meek appearance, retreating step by step, as if about to lose at any moment. Until the final moment, he barely finds a gap and wins by a hair's breadth. The entire arena erupts. "Luck! Absolutely luck!" "How could atrash possibly win four consecutive matches?" Doubts arise endlessly, but no one cares about Chen Ji's true strength—they only believe what they want to believe. And this is precisely the effect Chen Ji desires.

choices.text: Moderately reveal brilliance, deter the unworthy
choices.description: Display fifty percent of his strength, decisively defeat Zhao Tieshan, making certain restless individuals收敛.
choices.visible_cost: May attract more attention from higher-ups
choices.risk_hint: Lin Xiao and others will become more vigilant

text.content: Zhao Tieshan rushes forward with a dismissive sneer, thinking this would be just another routine victory. However, this time Chen Ji does not dodge—he raises his hand, spiritual energy forming a barrier that easily deflects all of his opponent's attacks. "You—" Zhao Tieshan's pupils contract sharply. The next instant, Chen Ji has already pressed forward, three palms striking the opponent's chest. As spiritual energy surges, Zhao Tieshan flies off the Arena Platform like a severed kite, landing with blood in his mouth. The entire arena falls silent. Those who were originally mocking Chen Ji find their smiles frozen on their faces.

The sun slants westward as the Sect Competition enters its final stage. Chen Ji stands at the finals entrance, his Outer Disciple/Servant robe already torn in several places, but his expression remains calm as still water. After five battles, his name has spread throughout Tianqing Sect—the biggest dark horse among Outer Disciples, the fighting machine amongtrash. Yet at this moment, no one dares to underestimate this"trash" anymore.

In a shadow beyond the crowd, an illusory figure stands motionless. It is the remnant soul of an elderly man. Were it not for deliberately revealing his presence, even a Nascent Soul stage expert would struggle to detect him. He watches Chen Ji on the Arena Platform, his eyes flickering with complex light. "The pieces in this scroll are more interesting than I anticipated." Mo Xiansheng murmurs, voice audible only to himself, "Chen Xuan, the person you chose is truly extraordinary." In his sleeve, an ancient worn scroll glows faintly—that is the second page of the Tianji Record—recording Chen Ji's fate trajectory for the next three hours.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng raises his hand, the remnant soul's condensed fingers tracing a rune in the air. The rune flashes and disappears. He murmurs to himself: "First observation, and I've already seen something interesting... The Su family's girl is about to discover you, Chen Ji." The words fade, and his figure vanishes from the shadows as if never existed.

text.content: Meanwhile, on the exclusive viewing platform for Inner Disciple Senior Fellows, Su Qingyao withdraws her gaze. Her brow furrows slightly, fingertips unconsciously rubbing the Jade Pendant hanging at her waist. That is her spiritual perception treasure—the "Mirror of the Heart," capable of detecting subtle spiritual energy fluctuations that ordinary people cannot察觉. And just now, during those moments when Chen Ji struck, she clearly sensed a familiar energy fluctuation—strikingly similar to records she had seen in an ancient text.

dialogue.content: "Impossible..." Su Qingyao whispers, her gaze flickering, "Could that fluctuation be..." She rises abruptly, her gaze falling on Chen Ji on the Arena Platform once more. This time, she observes especially carefully—that seemingly timid servant disciple, every movement impossibly precise, as if he knew in advance what his opponent would do next. This is definitely not luck. "Chen Ji..." Su Qingyao truly records this name in her heart for the first time.

text.content: During the rest period before the finals, Chen Ji sits alone in the preparation area, eyes closed, regulating his breath. In reality, his consciousness has sunk into the Tianji Record. On that yellowed page, the river of fate flows, countless images flickering like a carousel. He sees what will happen in the next half hour— His finals opponent is Xuanwu Sect genius Han Lie. This battle, he must win.

However, an anomaly appears in the Tianji Record's vision— Behind Han Lie, Chen Ji sees another figure. It is a vague silhouette, obscured by the Heavenly Fate Lock's power, impossible to see clearly. But one thing is certain: that person's cultivation far exceeds everyone present. The old Sect Master, Ling Yuan. He is paying attention to this competition.

choice.prompt: The appearance of Ling Yuan in the Tianji Record's foresight means the old Sect Master has noticed you. What will you do at this moment?

choices.text: Conceal your aura, show weakness voluntarily
choices.description: Deliberately lose to Han Lie in the finals, making Ling Yuan think you're not worth noticing, avoiding premature exposure.
choices.visible_cost: Give up the chance to enter the top three
choices.risk_hint: May lose reputation, and Han Lie may not spare you anyway

text.content: When the finals begin, Chen Ji's performance is like a different person. He makes continuous mistakes, gets pressured by Han Lie, utterly狼狈. "Is this the person who defeated Zhao Tieshan?" Han Lie sneers, "Nothing special." He throws a fist toward Chen Ji's chest, confident of victory. However, at this instant, Chen Ji's eyes change—they become the eyes of a hunter looking at prey. "Brother Han, you were too careless." Chen Ji sidesteps, avoiding the blow at an impossible angle, while simultaneously counterattacking with a palm strike to the opponent's shoulder. Spiritual energy crashes, Han Lie's offensive instantly collapses. The entire arena erupts! Chen Ji actually stages a comeback at the final moment, reversing the match!

choices.description: Since you've already been spotted, might as well go all out, defeat Han Lie in your strongest form, let your strength speak for itself.
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose part of your strength
choices.visible_reward: Win respect, deter all the unworthy
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's hostility will increase, but your reputation will skyrocket

text.content: The moment the finals whistle sounds, Chen Ji no longer conceals. His movement suddenly increases by thirty percent, spiritual energy flowing as freely as if it were his own arm, each move precisely countering Han Lie's attacks. The Xuanwu Sect genius who once dominated the Sect Competition is now being beaten backwards! "Impossible!" Han Lie roars, activating all his cultivation, yet still gets suppressed by Chen Ji. The final palm strike lands on Han Lie's chest, sending him flying out of the arena. The entire arena falls silent. A moment later, a tsunami of cheers erupts—Outer Disciple/Servant Chen Ji has won the Sect Competition Outer Division Championship!

choices.text: Set up schemes in the shadows, divert the trouble
choices.description: Deliberately expose a flaw during the match, enticing Han Lie to cheat or break rules, using the rules to defeat him, avoiding direct conflict.
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise calculation and on-the-spot performance
choices.visible_reward: Win cleanly, and Han Lie will face sect punishment
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will face Han Lie's furious revenge

text.content: As the match reaches a critical moment, Chen Ji deliberately creates an opening. Han Lie predictably takes the bait, secretly动用了一件禁止使用的灵器. However, everything is within Chen Ji's expectations. "Brother Han, the Sect Competition clearly prohibits the use of spiritual artifacts above spirit rank." Chen Ji's voice is not loud, yet clearly carries across the entire arena, "Are you certain you want to do this?" Han Lie's face changes dramatically, but it's too late. The referee's spiritual detection instantly locks onto the artifact's energyfluctuation. "Xuanwu Sect Han Lie, illegally using a spiritual artifact, competition qualification revoked!" Chen Ji wins without fighting. Han Lie trembles with rage, his eyes crimson as he glares at Chen Ji: "You set me up!" "Brother speaks too harshly." Chen Ji bows slightly, his smile mild, "Your junior merely reminded Brother to observe the rules."

The tournament concludes as sunset dyes Tianqing Sect crimson. Chen Ji stands on the podium, accepting the Outer Division Champion token. His expression remains humble, even带着几分不知所措, as if all of this is merely a dream. "Chen Ji!" A cold voice calls from the crowd. Chen Ji looks over to see Su Qingyao walking through the人群 toward him. Her gaze differs from before—more investigative, more... attentive?

"Sister Su." Chen Ji bows slightly, his voice carrying appropriate nervousness, "May I know Sister's orders?" Su Qingyao stands before him, her gaze lingering on his face for a moment. At this distance, she can clearly perceive his aura—as expected, beneath that calm exterior lies a power she cannot see through. "Your performance today exceeded my expectations." Su Qingyao's voice is soft, audible only to the two of them, "Tomorrow at the hour of you, at the Rear Mountain Bamboo Grove, I have words for you." With that, she turns and leaves, her back cold and孤傲.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao initiates a meeting—this surprises Chen Ji. She is the only person who has察觉到 his abnormality. How will you handle this appointment?

choices.text: Gladly attend, treat her with sincerity
choices.description: Since you've already been discovered, might as well proactively reveal some secrets,争取苏青瑶成为盟友.
choices.visible_reward: May gain Su Qingyao's trust and assistance
choices.risk_hint: If she doesn't believe, consequences are unpredictable

text.content: The next day at the hour of you, Chen Ji arrives at the Rear Mountain Bamboo Grove as promised. Su Qingyao is already waiting there, moonlight filtering through the bamboo leaves, casting a cold outline upon her. "You came." She turns, her gaze sharp, "Now, can you tell me the truth?" Chen Ji is silent for a moment, then takes out the turtle shell from his sleeve: "What Sister Su wants to know may have its answer here." The moment he extends the turtle shell, Su Qingyao's pupils contract sharply—she senses it, that energy fluctuation exactly matching the records in ancient texts. "This is..."

choices.text: Attend the meeting but maintain distance, test her intentions
choices.description: First see what Su Qingyao wants to do, then decide how much information to reveal.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain information without exposing trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is very clever, may see through your disguise

text.content: Deep within the bamboo grove, Su Qingyao stands on a blue stone, moonlight勾勒出她清冷的轮廓. "You really came." Her voice carries a hint of surprise, "I thought you would avoid me." "Sister invited, your junior dares not refuse." Chen Ji stands three zhang away, posture respectful, "Only, I wonder what Sister wishes to ask?" Su Qingyao stares at him for a long while, then suddenly smiles: "You are very cautious, which is good. But have you considered that being overly cautious... is itself a kind of exposure?" Chen Ji's heart lurches, but his expression remains unmoved: "Sister's words, your junior does not understand." "No matter." Su Qingyao turns, her back to him, "Someday, you will be willing to tell me."

Night wind brushes through the bamboo grove, rustling. Chen Ji stands alone, gazing in the direction Su Qingyao departed, his eyes flickering with complex light. This woman is more perceptive than he imagined. "The Tianji Record holder..." he murmurs to himself, "It seems my path must be even more careful." Under the moonlight, his shadow stretches long. And in the shadows in the distance, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul appears once more. He watches all this, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth. "Interesting, this game grows ever more interesting." Tianqing Sect's night is destined not to be peaceful. The chess game of undercurrents has only just begun.

Three days after the tournament concludes, news quietly spreads through Tianqing Sect—Outer Disciple/Servant Chen Ji has been personally named by old Sect Master Ling Yuan to be taken as a personal disciple. The news sends shockwaves through all of Tianqing Sect. One must know that as old Sect Master, Ling Yuan has not personally taken a disciple in decades. His last personal disciple was Chen Xuan, who defected twenty years ago—that legendary figure whom the sect labeled a "traitor." And now,trash servant Chen Ji actually wants to follow in Chen Xuan's footsteps? Is this opportunity, or... a trap?

The night wind cuts like a blade as Su Qingyao's footsteps sound behind him. Chen Ji has just stepped out of the Scripture Collection Pavilion when he sees that familiar figure blocking his path. Under the moonlight, Su Qingyao's expression is more solemn than usual. Her gaze falls on Chen Ji, carrying an unprecedented seriousness. "Chen Ji." Her voice is soft, yet clearly pierces through the night wind, "I've investigated the origins of that turtle shell." Chen Ji's footsteps falter, alarm bells ringing in his heart, yet his expression remains one ofpanicked: "What turtle shell does Sister refer to? Your junior does not understand..." Su Qingyao steps forward, the distance between them so close they can almost feel each other's breath: "You understand." She pauses, her voice suddenly sharp, "That turtle shell—is exactly the same as the spiritual artifact used by Chen Xuan when he defected twenty years ago." Under the moonlight, the shadows of the two of them overlap.
